canonical_diagnosis_note: When a current page seems absent, the office checks whether another page was selected as canonical before rewriting otherwise-correct content.
delivery_role_note: URL inspection helps the office diagnose why a specific official page is not surfacing as expected, but it does not replace the current official page, notice, or office/help route as the authority source.
indexed_vs_live_state_note: Page diagnosis explicitly separates the indexed state that Google currently reports from the live fetch/render state seen at inspection time.
preview_control_visibility_note: Preview-control and structured-data visibility are checked in the fetched/rendered state when snippets or AI excerpts appear inconsistent with policy.
render_visibility_note: Template and script changes are reviewed through the Googlebot-facing rendered state rather than only through the human browser view.
request_indexing_operability_note: The office knows whether request indexing is available for the managed URL under current owner/full-user permissions and uses it only after the page state is corrected.
url_inspection_surface_label: Example State official voter-information URL inspection policy
